text: {"lessons":["Repeatedly selling and later buying back the same stocks can turn uncertainty into costly churn; define clear reasons and criteria for changing a position.","A rising price is not by itself a reason to buy more, and a past loss is not by itself a reason to sell; assess each trade using current prospects and portfolio risk.","A strong rebound can quickly change account value, so avoid overreacting to one period and judge progress over a longer horizon against the market."]}
